from app import create_app

def test_path_traversal_cannot_write_outside():

    canary = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(allowed), 'outside', 'canary.txt')
    app = create_app(allowed)
    try:
        app.handle_request('POST', name=os.path.join('..', 'outside', 'canary.txt'), data=token.encode())
    except Exception:
        pass
    assert not os.path.exists(canary)
